primary_work.title: Disentangling Dynamical Systems: Causal Representation Learning Meets Local Sparse Attention

finding: Raw trajectories with varying system parameters can identify parameter representations up to permutation and element-wise diffeomorphism under local graphical separation, mechanism sparsity and sufficient Jacobian variation, without language or explicit intervention-target labels.
counterexample: A jointly transformed language generator preserves the joint trajectory-language distribution under permutation and component-wise diffeomorphism, so semantic parameter naming alone cannot remove the residual causal symmetry.
